summary: Backend CRUD/regression checks passed. Desktop UI workflows for dashboard, student search/create, payment, class creation, documents, and camera fallback passed. Mobile inspection found horizontal overflow and a nonfunctional menu.

critical.issue: PaymentCreate accepts negative amounts and allows paid_amount to exceed total_fee; remaining is only clamped in dashboard display.

minor.issue: Dashboard labels values as monthly/current but returns all stored payments and expenses without date filtering.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px viewport document scrollWidth is 419px; stat cards and dashboard tables extend beyond the viewport, causing horizontal page scrolling and clipped content.
Mobile menu button is visible but has no onClick behavior, so the hidden sidebar cannot be opened on mobile.

integration_issues.issue: Makbuzu yazdır button invokes the same window.print() contract preview as the contract button; no receipt preview/payment breakdown or PDF generation is implemented.

issues: Right-side metric text is visibly clipped because the two-column card grid exceeds the viewport.

action_items: Add positive amount and overpayment validation to POST /api/payments and show the error in the modal.
Filter dashboard payment/expense metrics by the intended reporting period.
Fix mobile grid/table sizing so document scrollWidth never exceeds viewport width.
Implement mobile menu state and display the sidebar/navigation when [data-testid=mobile-menu] is clicked.
Implement a distinct receipt preview/output with student, payment method, date, amount, and balance details.
critical_code_review_comments: Modal submit has no try/catch or visible error state; API failures leave the modal open without user-facing feedback.
Many critical form controls (student details, payment method/bank/note, class fields) lack data-testid attributes despite the mandatory testability guideline.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ student/payment/class/expense records through regression tests and UI Flow student/payment/class records; no delete endpoints exist for cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All five backend tests passed. Desktop critical flows passed. Recheck mobile overflow/menu and receipt output after fixes; then test negative/overpayment validation.
rca of the issue: Mobile overflow is caused by the 2-column .stats-grid and recent payment table retaining intrinsic widths at 390px; .table-panel overflow:hidden clips content but does not prevent document-level width expansion. The menu defect is direct: mobile-menu renders without a click handler or mobile sidebar state. Receipt defect is direct: both document buttons call window.print() and render the same contract-preview component.
